headline: T Swift's Baddies Drop a 196 Bomb While Little Peckers Stay Little
subhead: Week 10 was less a slate of football games and more a public execution, with one team hanging a buck-twelve on a manager who apparently forgot to set a lineup.
matchOfTheWeek: McBridesStrangeWhiteHock squeaked past Christian McCalfinjury by 6.60 in the only game that didn't feel like a hate crime. Trey McBride dropped 32.2 to justify the team name existing, while McCalfinjury watched Dalton Schultz hang 21.8 on the bench — a margin that would've flipped the entire result. Set. Your. Lineup. Matt.
powerRankingsShakeup: T Swift's Baddies just announced themselves as the league boogeyman with a 196-burger, while Little Peckers and QAmon are speedrunning the basement. Browning Out also quietly stacked a 159 and nobody's talking about it.
mainRecap:
Let's start with the war crime. T Swift's Baddies put up 196.14 on Little Peckers' 84.22 — a 111.92-point beating that should be investigated by the Hague. Gibbs went for 38.2, Stafford added 26.9, and the lineup ran at 98.9% efficiency. Meanwhile Little Peckers scored 84 points, which is roughly what Unc Aaron Jones puts up by himself on a good Sunday. Embarrassing. Cover your peckers, they're showing.

The Good Ladds dropped 182.98 on QAmon and it was basically the Jonathan Taylor show — 49.6 points from one running back is just disrespectful to the sport. To make it worse, QAmon left Dillon Gabriel and his 20.08 points on the bench while Tiny-Handed Vampire and dead rat presumably did nothing. King Unc would be ashamed.

Browning Out hung 159 on Rub My Chubb behind a 40.5 from Achane, and Big D somehow still found a way to lose by 50 WHILE leaving 34.2 points on his bench. Jalen Nailor went for 23.4 in street clothes from your perspective. Kittle dropped 27.9 and it didn't matter. That is a managerial felony.

Nut Olave Your Face beat OnlyFants behind 25.1 from Nail Polish Enthusiast, but Cubby gets dragged for letting Jeudy's 19.8 rot on the pine. Don't get cocky Nick — Tez Johnson dropped 20.2 on YOUR bench too, you both lose at lineup-setting.

Egbukkake handled Stroud Boys despite Money Mill$ (28.68) and The Prodigal Son (28.0) trying to single-handedly drag bjewett to a win. Then bjewett spent the week trading away Davis Mills and Jacoby Brissett like he's running a QB pawn shop. Pick a direction, my guy.

McBride saved Rocks. Schultz buried Wunder. Football, baby.

weeklyAwards.title: Lineup Arsonist of the Week
weeklyAwards.blurb: Left 34.2 on the bench in a 50-point loss — Big D managed his roster like he was trying to throw the game on purpose.

weeklyAwards.title: The Hague Award
weeklyAwards.blurb: 196.14 points is not a fantasy score, it's a felony assault charge.

weeklyAwards.title: Stat-Padding in a Loss MVP
weeklyAwards.blurb: Money Mill$ and The Prodigal Son combined for 56.68 and bjewett still lost — then traded both QBs away like he was rage-quitting in real time.

weeklyAwards.title: Why Are You Even Here Trophy
weeklyAwards.blurb: 84.22 points. Unc carried a corpse. The rest of the roster filed for PTO.
